title: 1990 Topps Woolworth Baseball Highlights #29 Dave Henderson Oakland Athletics
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
1990 Topps Woolworth Baseball Highlights #29 Dave Henderson, Oakland Athletics. "Dave's 3 Long Hits Overpower Giants": a double and two home runs with 4 RBI in the A's 13-7 win over the Giants in Game 3 of the 1989 World Series.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
